title: Alko reports data breach in its product-returns app; customers' contact details may have leaked
date_note: The STT article, marked 'today' at 10:03, gives no calendar date; the page's own publication day (25 November) is used as the disclosure day.
geo_basis: Alko is the Finnish alcohol retailer; the articles name no city, so the pin is a general location in Finland.
summary: Alko said it found a data breach in the app used to process customers' product returns. Customers' names, email addresses or phone numbers may have leaked to an outside party, affecting customers who made returns between 5 August and 18 November. Alko IT director Jani Partonen said in a press release that the app does not handle national ID numbers, payment card or bank details, or Alko web-service passwords.
plain: Alko says a data breach hit its returns app, and contact details of customers who made returns may have leaked. The app does not handle ID numbers, card or bank details or web-service passwords, its IT director says.
exec: Alko says customers' contact details may have leaked from its returns app, which is out of use until safe operation is confirmed.
action: Alko warns customers who made returns about unexpected contacts that seem to come from Alko, especially requests for information, payment or opening a link; returns continue in stores without the app.

validation.note: Länsi-Savo and Karjalainen carry the same STT wire text (one report); Alko's own press release could not be found by search.
